definition: A sentence-final particle used for emphasis or to soften a statement. One of the most iconic Manglish words.
example: Don't worry lah, it's not a big deal.

definition: An exclamation of surprise, admiration, or shock.
example: Wah, this nasi lemak damn good!

definition: An expression of dismay, frustration, or exasperation.
example: Aiyo, you forgot to bring the tickets again?!

definition: To not invite someone. Used to express feeling left out.
example: You all went for teh tarik bojio me?!

definition: To hang out, chill, or lounge around doing nothing in particular.
example: Nothing to do tonight, just lepak at mamak lah.

definition: To eat. Also used as an invitation to go eat together.
example: Eh, let's go makan — I'm starving already.

definition: Careless, sloppy, or 'whatever goes'. Can mean easy-going or haphazardly done.
example: Cincai only lah, any food also can.

definition: Confused, clueless, or not aware of what's happening around you.
example: He walked into the wrong lecture hall — so blur one.

definition: Extremely enjoyable, satisfying, or pleasurable.
example: After a long day, a cold shower feels so shiok!

definition: Literally 'to cut', but used to mean a buzzkill or mood-ruiner.
example: We planned a picnic but it rained. So potong.

definition: Anxious, nervous, or panicky — especially over small things.
example: Why so kan cheong? The exam is still one week away.

definition: To takeaway or pack food to go.
example: I'll tapau nasi goreng for dinner tonight.

definition: Fear of losing out. Describes someone overly competitive or desperate to come out on top.
example: He queued up at 5am just to get a free sample — so kiasu.

definition: More, again, or even more so. Used for added emphasis.
example: This new place is good, but the old one lagi nice.

definition: An exclamation of shock, surprise, or horror — like 'oh no!' or 'oh my goodness!'
example: Alamak, I left my wallet at home!

definition: To reserve or claim a seat, usually by placing an item on it.
example: I choped a seat already, just go order the food first.

definition: Embarrassed, shy, or feeling ashamed. Also used when declining something out of politeness.
example: Paiseh lah, can you repeat what you said? I wasn't listening.

definition: To settle or sort something out. Signals a task is handled.
example: Don't worry about the booking, I already kautim.

definition: An exclamation of disbelief, frustration, or amazement. Similar to 'oh my god'.
example: Walao, you finished the whole plate in 5 minutes?!

definition: To reverse a vehicle. Derived from the nautical phrase 'go astern'.
example: Gostan a bit lah, you're too close to the wall.

definition: Literally 'above/up', but used to mean posh, fancy, or upper-class.
example: She only eats at atas restaurants — never mamak with us.

definition: Stupid or foolish. Can be used affectionately between close friends.
example: Aiyo, bodohnya — you pressed the wrong floor again!

definition: Arrogant, showing off, or acting like you're better than others.
example: Since he got promoted, he's been so action already.

definition: A term of endearment meaning 'love' or 'dear'. Also used to express a pity or waste.
example: Sayang lah, the cafe closed down — their coffee was amazing.

definition: To endure, withstand, or hold back. Often used to describe tolerating something difficult.
example: The durian smell is so strong, cannot tahan.

definition: Finished, done, or all gone. Can also mean 'you're in trouble now'.
example: The char kway teow habis already? We came too late lah.

definition: Crazy or insane. Used both literally and as an intensifier meaning 'extremely'.
example: Gila lah this traffic, we've been stuck for an hour.

definition: Shy, embarrassed, or ashamed.
example: So malu lah — I called the lecturer by the wrong name.

definition: Easy, comfortable, or relaxed. Sometimes used sarcastically.
example: Wah, very senang life — always on holiday one.

definition: Doing whatever you like without care for rules or others. Means 'as you please'.
example: Cannot just come and go suka-suka lah, got rules one.
